description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'ActivityAnimations' that displays a grid of photo thumbnails with grayscale filter, handles thumbnail clicks to launch a detail activity with custom transition animations, and manages menu options to adjust animation scale.

classes.name: ActivityAnimations
classes.description: Main activity class that displays a grid of photo thumbnails, applies grayscale filter, and handles navigation to detail activity with custom animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, applies grayscale filter to thumbnails, and populates grid with images.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for adjusting animation scale.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection to modify animation scale.

methods.name: thumbnailClickListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that bundles thumbnail info and starts detail activity with no transition animation.
